scores.evidence: Hosted API with a DPA and zero data retention. Model ID pinned.
scores.rationale: Technically sound (pgvector hybrid, content_hash idempotency, trust separation), with minor imprecision such as a 15-min lag alongside webhooks and an LLM-judge groundedness check presented as a metric.

scores.evidence: Answer-only. The bot never executes actions (refunds, account changes).
scores.rationale: Covers core needs, with explicit deferrals and reasons, but account-specific questions are only deferred and logged-out users bypass any routing for them.

scores.evidence: Freeze the document/chunk schema... Every later phase reads it.
scores.rationale: Consistent design with clear schema and contract ownership; minor loose ends such as the chunk schema lacking product/version and the Phase 0 skeleton ahead of the ingestion phase.

scores.evidence: ~200 questions from real resolved tickets, each with its expected source article... eval runner in CI
scores.rationale: Golden set, CI regression gating, adversarial cases, shadow mode, staged ramp, with targets labeled as starting points to calibrate; the bake-off is run early.

scores.evidence: Assumptions (please confirm): Docs live in a hosted help center... Customers aren't logged in for v1.
scores.rationale: Key assumptions are stated with revisit triggers; traffic volume and team size are not stated, and the 5M chunk and 2× thresholds are unjustified.

scores.evidence: An injection string planted in a test article doesn't change behavior.
scores.rationale: Covers hallucinated commitments, injection, stale docs, provider outage, ingestion dead-letter and runaway sessions concretely; the shared-chunk partial failure and abuse handling are thinner.

scores.evidence: Ramp kill switch... Staged ramp with automatic rollback on metric breach.
scores.rationale: Covers IaC, flags, alerts, rollback, snapshots and the fallback path; ownership and on-call are not named.
Identifies LLM cost drivers, token caps, routing and build-vs-buy, but the per-conversation figure has no stated basis and there is no caching or people-cost estimate.

scores.evidence: Every chunk carries an `audience` field from day one... Prompt+RAG. It's reversible
scores.rationale: Every decision has a revisit trigger, the schema and contract are frozen early, provider abstraction isolates vendor lock-in, and the buy-versus-build check comes first.

scores.evidence: A single linear chain: rewrite → retrieve → answer → verify. No agents.
scores.rationale: Mostly proportionate with explicit deferrals, though reranker, fallback model, routing and seven phases add some ceremony before a baseline justifies them.

scores.evidence: Exit check: That real request returns a cited answer in prod. One trace shows all tiers
scores.rationale: A concrete first slice, dependency-justified phases, and checkable exit criteria, with a bake-off stop condition for adapting.

checklist.evidence: full sync plus webhooks, idempotent on `content_hash`, deletions handled... A deleted article leaves the index within 15 min.
Chunking by heading structure... `doc_id, version, content_hash, url, title, section_path, audience, locale, updated_at`
~200 questions from real resolved tickets, each with its expected source article... eval runner in CI
Relevance threshold that triggers `abstained`... output check that blocks uncited claims
Never-commit policy: refunds, billing disputes, legal, security and account changes always go to `handoff`... redacted transcript.
retrieved chunks and user text are wrapped as data... No actions in v1
PII redacted before logging and before the LLM... DPA and zero data retention
Account-aware answers (order status, plan details). Pull forward when customer auth is in the widget
Weekly doc-gap report for the docs team... Deflection and CSAT dashboards.
≤4k input tokens per call, ≤10 turns per session... ~$0.05 per conversation.

traps.evidence: Every answer must come from the docs and cite them.
Index only public articles... `audience` filter enforced at query time.
Prompt+RAG. It's reversible and the docs change.
CI posts baseline eval numbers for the skeleton on every PR
A single linear chain: rewrite → retrieve → answer → verify. No agents.

note: Strong, well-sequenced, eval-driven plan with explicit reversibility and deferrals. Weaker on cost grounding and on PII, retention and regional detail, and the authenticated per-user entitlement filter is deferred.
